They are AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED, CHECK_TRIAGE_TARGET_FILES_GUARD_ENABLED, CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED, HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_HOLD_EXPIRY_ENABLED, PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT_VERIFY_ENABLED, RESOLVER_PROVENANCE_CHECK_ENABLED, STALL_PR_RESOLVE_IMPLEMENTATION_FIRST_ENABLED, UNBLOCK_EXISTING_PR_ROUTING_ENABLED, UNBLOCK_HOLD_PATCH_EQUIVALENCE_ENABLED, UNBLOCK_PLACEHOLDER_RECURRENCE_CHECK_ENABLED and WORKFLOW_HEAL_RED_MAIN_GROUPING_ENABLED.

The daily stage-switch watch also can never alert on these switches. All four reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py:41-45,128-143 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: README_NOT_REPOSITORY_VARIABLES has no entry for the default-true README row `GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED`. That name is not a repository variable: the workflows read `vars.AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED`, because GitHub rejects variable names that start with `GITHUB_`.
  WHY: test_every_readme_true_switch_is_in_registry (assert at line 141) fails shard 23 even after the registry entries land. The fix is an exclusion-map entry, not a registry entry, because line 130 asserts the registry and the exclusion map do not overlap. All three reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- README.md:GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED row | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The README table row names the variable GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED, which is not valid as an Actions variable name, while implement.yml reads vars.AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED.
  WHY: Users who follow the README will set a variable that does not exist, so the setting silently has no effect, and the registry-parity tests in tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py fail. Rated BLOCKER.
- README.md:477 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED` row still contains unescaped `|` characters in its inline outcome list and does not document the `reason=add_failed` outcome that `scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh` emits.
  WHY: The unescaped pipes split the GitHub-flavored Markdown table row into extra cells, and the latest README edit shown in the last-run diff is not in the current row. Rated NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash state the opposite: the pipes are escaped as `\|` and reason=add_failed is documented.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The PR title lists "operator-step tick" as a deliverable. Phase 9 of docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md asks for: an extension to `operator_step_issue.py tick` behind OPERATOR_STEP_DAILY_TICK_ENABLED (default true); a "Tick observable operator steps" daily step in the `collect-logs` job of `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml`; tests; and an `OPERATOR_STEP_TICK` log prefix.
  expected_change_site: scripts/operator_step_issue.py (tick), .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml (collect-logs step), scripts/operator_step_daily_tick.sh [new], tests/test_operator_step_issue.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff and changed-files list contain no Phase 9 daily tick changes. A grep over scripts/operator_step_issue.py finds no OPERATOR_STEP_DAILY_TICK_ENABLED. A grep over .github/workflows finds no "Tick observable operator steps" step and no `operator_step_issue.py tick` invocation. The PR description does not defer the deliverable, although prior editor runs recorded it as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED because the plan files Phase 9 as its own wave of #9650. Severity: MAJOR from all three reviewers. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly does not count this as a gap.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/stage_switches.json:"switches" array | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The 11 default-on `vars.<NAME>_ENABLED || 'true'` switches this PR adds are not in the registry. They are AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED (implement.yml:28, review_autofix.yml:133), CHECK_TRIAGE_TARGET_FILES_GUARD_ENABLED (check_failure_triage.yml:266), CONFLICT_MODIFY_DELETE_TAKE_BASE_ENABLED, RESOLVER_PROVENANCE_CHECK_ENABLED, HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_HOLD_EXPIRY_ENABLED, STALL_PR_RESOLVE_IMPLEMENTATION_FIRST_ENABLED, UNBLOCK_EXISTING_PR_ROUTING_ENABLED, UNBLOCK_HOLD_PATCH_EQUIVALENCE_ENABLED, UNBLOCK_PLACEHOLDER_RECURRENCE_CHECK_ENABLED, PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT_VERIFY_ENABLED and WORKFLOW_HEAL_RED_MAIN_GROUPING_ENABLED. The registry arrived with merge 9d1d259 (#9994).
  WHY: tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py:105-111 fails on CI shard 21 of run 45634679687, so tests-system-python fails and `lint` blocks merge. The daily watch also never reports these switches. Fix: add a {name, default "true", stage} entry for each switch, matching test_registry_entries_are_well_formed (lines 146-156). PLAN_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT_VERIFY_ENABLED may also carry on_values ["1","yes","on"].
- tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py:41-45,128-143 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: README row `GITHUB_AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED` is not a repository variable (the workflows read `vars.AI_PLAN_GRANT_WRITE_ENABLED`) and has no README_NOT_REPOSITORY_VARIABLES entry.
  WHY: `assert sorted(missing) == []` at line 141 fails shard 23, and the shard stays red even after the registry entries are added. Fix: add an exclusion-map entry with a reason. Do not add it to the registry, because line 130 forbids overlap.
- NAMING / BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY: NONE. The README edit escapes its pipes as `\|`, and the documented `IMPLEMENT_GITHUB_AI_GRANT ... [ reason=add_failed]` shape matches scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. The "operator-step tick" (Phase 9) is not counted as a gap, because the plan schedules it as its own sub-issue PR and wave of #9650 and prior runs recorded it as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED.
